podcast.body: This song was the Billboard year-end number one for 1990, co-written by the group (daughters of Brian Wilson, and John and Michelle Phillips) with producer Glen Ballard. It topped the Hot 100 for just one week in early summer 1990, but this brief run was enough to secure its year-end title over longer-lasting hits. The song has seen a critical re-evaluation, being added to Pitchfork's list of the 250 best songs of the 1990s. "Wilson Phillips three daughters of 60s rock royalty Brian Wilson of the Beach Boys and the mamas and the Papa's John and Michelle Phillips co-wrote hold on with producer Glenn Ballard and it topped the hot 100 for just one week in the early summer of 1990."
